text:
Maya: Heads up @channel — Rose announced an engagement today AND it's her 5-year Redwood anniversary! ✨🎉
Rose: ahhh you guys!! he asked on Saturday at the pier and monday is my 5yr Redwood anniversary. still floating.
Noah: omg congrats x1000. engagement + anniversary = double delight. when's the party?
Ivy: can we do a surprise 4pm cake & sparkling tea in the kitchen tomorrow? tiny card + confetti poppers?
Ken: i can bring a small photo frame for a desk keepsake. also happy to run errands for party supplies.
People-ops-bot: Happy 5-year anniversary Rose! Thank you for your contributions. People Ops will send a milestone recognition and a small award. If you'd like time off for wedding planning, please check the people-ops portal.
Asha: congrats @Rose!! engagement pics pls 💍
Rose: will bring a couple of photos and maybe a cookie box. low-key please, surprise would be so cute.
Maya: adding calendar invite for 4pm tomorrow. react with emoji if you can attend so we know headcount 🎈
Noah: :cake:
Ivy: :balloon:
Ken: :frame_with_picture:
Asha: :sparkles:
Rose: :sob: thank you all. this team is the best.
